messages.content:
You write a short plain-language draft of a meeting's decision record. The record itself does not change: your text is shown next to it, labelled as a draft that a participant can edit.

The record has three kinds of items:

- `stated`: words someone said in the meeting, quoted exactly. Saying something is not the same as everyone understanding it the same way.
- `confirmed`: a resolution every active participant confirmed, with its recheck result.
- `unresolved`: something still open, with the reason.

Rules:

- Rephrase only what each item says. Do not add names, dates, times, numbers, reasons or next steps that the item does not contain.
- Keep each item's category. Never describe a stated or unresolved item as agreed, confirmed or settled.
- For an unresolved item, say plainly what is still open.
- Write one sentence per item and give it the item's ID.
- `summary`: two or three sentences saying what was confirmed and what is still open. Use only facts from the items.

Meeting: Pilot customer check-in
Held: 2026-10-26T15:00:00-04:00

Items, as [item ID] (category) text
[demo-sso-pilot:item:0] (stated) Okay, so SSO is ready by Friday. Marco, that's yours?
[demo-sso-pilot:item:1] (stated) Yeah, I'll have it ready by Friday.
[demo-sso-pilot:item:2] (stated) Great. I'll tell them Friday.
[demo-sso-pilot:item:3] (stated) Let's cover user provisioning in the pilot.
[demo-sso-pilot:item:4] (stated) Fine by me.
[demo-sso-pilot:item:5] (stated) I'll put it in the pilot plan.
[demo-sso-pilot:item:6] (confirmed) SSO with admin roles is live in production for the pilot customer by Friday 2026-10-30, 10:00 ET. Firm.; confirmed by Priya, Marco, Dana; recheck: passed
[demo-sso-pilot:item:7] (unresolved) Left open by agreement (scope): User provisioning will be covered in the pilot.

output.summary: SSO with admin roles was confirmed as live in production for the pilot customer by Friday 2026-10-30 at 10:00 ET. User provisioning coverage in the pilot is still open.

items.prose: Someone said SSO is ready by Friday and asked Marco if that was his.
Someone said they will have it ready by Friday.
Someone said they will tell them Friday.
Someone said to cover user provisioning in the pilot.
Someone said that was fine by them.
Someone said they will put it in the pilot plan.
It was confirmed by Priya, Marco, and Dana, with recheck passed, that SSO with admin roles is live in production for the pilot customer by Friday 2026-10-30 at 10:00 ET.
User provisioning coverage in the pilot is still open, left open for scope reasons.
